# autoMBIST

> An open-source, OpenRAM-integrated MBIST (Memory Built-In Self-Test) + BIRA
> (Built-In Redundancy Analysis) + BISR (Built-In Self-Repair) generator and
> march-algorithm research platform, proven through open RTL-to-GDS physical
> closure on the sky130 open PDK.

autoMBIST is a CLI that generates memory-test and memory-repair RTL for
OpenRAM-compiled SRAM macros: march-algorithm MBIST controllers, a 2D
row+column BIRA solver, and both tester-driven and fully autonomous on-chip
BISR (self-repair with no external tester at all). A three-real-macro sky130
subsystem, self-repair included, has been hardened clean through LibreLane
3.0.5 (zero detailed-routing violations, LVS-clean including power). A real
RV32I CPU (PicoRV32) has also been shown booting and running real code
through self-repaired memory. It is a research and open-source-tooling
project. Timing signoff and DRC/LVS closure are the downstream PD/STA
flow's responsibility, not autoMBIST's: it generates and functionally
verifies RTL.

## Documentation

- [Documentation home](https://ranaumarnadeem.github.io/autoMBIST/): full site navigation
- [Introduction](https://ranaumarnadeem.github.io/autoMBIST/introduction.html): what the tool is and its two subsystems (classic MBIST generator, redundancy/repair research platform)
- [Quickstart](https://ranaumarnadeem.github.io/autoMBIST/quickstart.html): install and run a first generate + simulate pass
- [Installation](https://ranaumarnadeem.github.io/autoMBIST/installation.html): Nix (recommended, matches CI) and manual setup
- [Example](https://ranaumarnadeem.github.io/autoMBIST/example.html): a full walkthrough including redundancy repair
- [Flow architecture](https://ranaumarnadeem.github.io/autoMBIST/flow.html): how generation, simulation, and hardening fit together
- [Algo-Shell Guide](https://ranaumarnadeem.github.io/autoMBIST/algo-shell-guide.html) (experimental): the research-mode subsystem (`autombist test` / `autombist algo`)
- [Configuration reference](https://ranaumarnadeem.github.io/autoMBIST/configuration.html): the config file schema
- [LibreLane hardening recipe](https://ranaumarnadeem.github.io/autoMBIST/librelane.html): the proven RTL-to-GDS macro-integration recipe
- [Challenges](https://ranaumarnadeem.github.io/autoMBIST/challenges.html): real problems hit during development and how they were resolved
- [Roadmap](https://ranaumarnadeem.github.io/autoMBIST/roadmap.html): what's built and what's not
- [Advanced Guide](https://ranaumarnadeem.github.io/autoMBIST/advanced-guide.html): architecture, CLI reference, multi-port guide, diagnosis reports, demo, and macro-integration notes

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/ranaumarnadeem/autoMBIST): source code, issues, CI
- [Real-CPU self-repair demo](https://github.com/ranaumarnadeem/autoMBIST/blob/main/flow/soc/README.md): a real RV32I core booting through self-repaired memory
- [CITATION.cff](https://github.com/ranaumarnadeem/autoMBIST/blob/main/CITATION.cff): how to cite this software
